messages:
Priya (People Ops): Quick q — we have a contractor who was onboarding and missed open enrollment for FSA/HSA. Is there a midyear enrollment route or QLE options? They start 2/1 but paperwork landed late.
Alex W: are contractors eligible for FSA/HSA? thought they'd only get limited benefits.
Priya (People Ops): Good point — not all contractors. This is a long-term contractor on payroll who gets benefits per their contract. So yes for this case. Looking for process: can we enroll retroactively or do payroll cutoffs block us?
Lisa HR: Short answer: possible but depends on timing. If paperwork is within 30 days of hire/date of eligibility we can do a QLE add. If outside, need exec exception + benefits team sign-off. Please DM docs.
Jamal (Payroll): Payroll cutoff is the 15th for 1st-of-month coverage. For a 2/1 coverage date, changes must be in the portal by 1/14 COB to reflect Feb deductions. After that we can still add but deductions start next available pay period. For retro pay we need a signed exception and payroll adjustment request.
BenefitsBot: Automated reminder: Submit enrollment changes here: https://internal.benefits/redwood/enroll — use code "MIDYR-FSA" for midyear intake. See FAQ: https://internal.benefits/redwood/faq#midyear
Maria P: If we do retroactive add and process payroll adjustment, does employee get pre-tax treatment retro? Tax team had said adjustments can be messy.
Lisa HR: Tax treatment: HSA contributions can be adjusted pre-tax retro if done within current calendar year and records updated. FSA is trickier for election changes midyear — we need a QLE justification. We'll loop in tax for confirmation. @Jamal pls advise on journal entries.
Jamal (Payroll): We'll do a manual retro calculation and code it as an adjustment. Need signed QLE + enrollment form + manager approval. Send to payroll@redwood.com with subject "Retro Enrollment Adj — [employee name]". Expect 1-2 pay cycles to show.
Priya (People Ops): Thanks team. Action items:
- Alex: confirm contractor agreement includes benefits eligibility and share with me.
- Employee: submit portal form and upload ID + hire docs.
- Lisa/Jamal: ticket to benefits/payroll for exception if outside 30 days.
I'll follow up once paperwork lands. :thumbsup:
Alex W: noted, sending contract now.
Maria P: thanks, I'll ask employee to submit portal and cc you @Priya.
BenefitsBot: Ticket created: #BEN-45782 for retro enrollment workflow. ETA: 3 business days for review.
Priya (People Ops): tagging this resolved for now — will reopen if we hit blockers. Thanks all.
